source: Technology Promotion Project to Increase Productivity Around Tonle Sap (TSTD — TA 7305-CAM), watermelon (ដំណាំឪឡឹក) technical training booklet, prepared by the project's agricultural techniques and extension officer in cooperation with East West Seed International, November 2016. Contact: livleanghy@gmail.com
text:
Raising seedlings in a nursery helps seeds germinate faster and reduces early crop losses from strong sun and heavy rain compared with sowing directly in the field. The booklet recommends building a simple shaded nursery structure with the following dimensions:

Roof/shed height at the ridge should be about 1.8 to 2 meters, high enough for a person to walk in and out comfortably to tend the seedlings.

Side wall height should be about 0.4 to 1 meter from the ground.

Width of the structure should be about 0.4 to 1 meter.

The structure should have a roof cover to protect against rain, and shade netting/cloth over the growing area to reduce heat and direct sun exposure on the young seedlings.

A net/mesh wall around the sides is also recommended to help protect the seedlings from insect pests entering the nursery.
